generationMethod: Local SVG authoring and sharp rasterization; no network, external image generation, credentials, or application data.
iconRasterization: Preserve SVG alpha coverage, then set RGB of every nontransparent icon pixel to its single declared ink color; this removes overlap-rounding artifacts. Logo is rasterized directly without this step.
spriteLayout: horizontal; frame n begins at x = n × frameWidth

logoMotion.method: Three finite wave packets travel strictly upward across original smoke control points, with different birth times, widths, curls, and lifetimes. The root envelope reaches zero at source y=235; body coordinates and transforms remain unchanged. Packets leave and decay, never play backward. This is stylized brand motion, not a fluid simulation.
logoMotion.packetTimeUnits: time is fraction of 4-second cycle; source centerY decreases upward

verification.scope: Generated design assets only; not business, Electron, or target-system acceptance.
